title: Feature Request: Carbs on Board
body:
Hi,

I find myself often switching to nightscout to look at the CoB value, which I find extremely useful and which gives me some orientation if I have to increase my IoB.
Would it be possible (and not too difficult) to add this value to xdrip?

Thanks a lot for all your work and effort!
I really rely on this app.

comments.body: Would love to have it too :)
